These actions included the release of cash tied up in trade receivables and inventories. During the year, inventories and trade receivables 20 April 2021 reduced by Kes 1,554m (2019: Kes 1,041m) and Kes 885m (2019: 138m) respectively, releasing a total of Kes 2,439m (2019: 1,179m) of cash tied therein. Additionally, with improved profitability, total cash generated from operations was Kes 6,860m (2019: Kes 3,659m), a growth of 87.5%. The exceptional performance of the Group in 2020, both at profitability and cash flow level, despite a global pandemic is a testimony of the Group’s resilience in the face of adversity.
